item.title: Rob Dillingham On Wolves Tenure, Opportunity With Bulls
item.description: The Timberwolves traded their unprotected 2031 first-round pick and a 2030 pick swap to San Antonio to acquire Rob Dillingham with the eighth overall pick in the 2024 draft.
